title: celld-smoke input — cell coordinates and test payload

cellId.description: Identifier of the durable cell to connect to (e.g. article:01J... or smoke:test)

endpoint.description: Optional custom celld daemon endpoint (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9876)

testKey.description: Entity ID key to write and verify in the cell

testData.description: Payload to persist and verify in the cell
